lines.text: Tuesday, two o'clock. Your whole crew is out on a job. And the phone is ringing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: AfterRing is an AI receptionist for your business line. It can take every call, or only the ones your team misses.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Set it to step in after fifteen seconds unanswered, or after hours. It answers in your company's name.

text.headline: Every call, or only the ones you miss.

steps.title: Call comes in
steps.sub: Your desk or cell rings as normal.

steps.title: You choose
steps.sub: It takes every call, or only the ones nobody picks up.

steps.title: 15 seconds, or after hours
steps.sub: The usual setting: it steps in when nobody has answered.

lines.speaker: receptionist
lines.text: Northwind Heating, this is Kylie. I'm an AI assistant, and this call may be recorded. How can I help?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Our heat just went out. It's freezing in here.

lines.speaker: receptionist
lines.text: Sorry to hear that. Let's get someone out. Can I get your name, and is this the best number to reach you?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Dana Reyes. And yeah, this number's fine.

lines.speaker: receptionist
lines.text: Thanks, Dana. I have tomorrow at eight, or eleven thirty. Which works?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Eight.

lines.speaker: receptionist
lines.text: You're booked for eight tomorrow morning. Someone will confirm before the visit.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The moment it books a job, you get a text.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The summary lands in your inbox, and the visit is already on your calendar.

text.headline: You see every call. Without stopping work.

lines.text: Try it for thirty days. If it hasn't booked you one job by day thirty, you owe nothing.

lines.text: After that, it's two twenty-five a month, flat, plus a one-time four twenty-five set-up fee, charged only after your first booking.
